'''R-N05''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] in service to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R-N05 appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', serving as a vendor for companion customization.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
